# MediaKit

> MediaKit is a free browser-based image and video converter. Selected media files are processed locally on the user's device and are not uploaded to MediaKit servers for conversion.

## Main tools

- Image converter: https://mediakit.upupdays.com/image
- Video converter: https://mediakit.upupdays.com/video
- HEIC to JPG: https://mediakit.upupdays.com/image/heic-to-jpg
- HEIC to PNG: https://mediakit.upupdays.com/image/heic-to-png
- WebP to JPG: https://mediakit.upupdays.com/image/webp-to-jpg
- WebP to PNG: https://mediakit.upupdays.com/image/webp-to-png
- PNG to JPG: https://mediakit.upupdays.com/image/png-to-jpg
- MOV to MP4: https://mediakit.upupdays.com/video/mov-to-mp4
- WebM to MP4: https://mediakit.upupdays.com/video/webm-to-mp4

## Product facts

- Image outputs focus on JPG, PNG, and WebP.
- Image compression reduces JPG, PNG and WebP file sizes using browser-side presets; results depend on the source and settings.
- Video compression can reduce MP4 file sizes; browser memory, codecs and device performance affect results.
- Video conversion uses FFmpeg WebAssembly in supported modern browsers.
- Users can process up to 15 files per session, 150 MB per file, and 1000 MB total.
- No account is required and MediaKit does not add a watermark.
